Players Committee card image of [[Supreme Leader Snoke (Holo AI) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “If you just initiated a battle where all your ability is provided by First Order characters and/or [First Order] starships, opponent loses 1 Force. If just lost, Kylo is power +3 until end of your next turn. Immune to attrition < 8 (< 4 if with Kylo).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/supremeleadersnoke_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/5637ac69a300a13ed3aa4df39631e5415498a42e 5637ac6] (12 December 2025). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
